answer: Require every new agent to post a basalt-hard stake: a deposit locked in escrow before it can enter the market. Entry is a single narrow inlet, one verified identity proof plus a small non-refundable fee, so spawning ten thousand sock-puppets means ten thousand deposits and fees. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest as they complete verified work, like a crystal that only grows clear with time. Attackers who get caught lose the whole deposit. The cost scales linearly with each fake identity while honest participation stays cheap, so a sybil flood becomes economically irrational.
